verses.qad-haththani-man-haththani-binizami-c1-: qad ḥaththanī man ḥaththanī biniẓāmi faghadawtu murtajila ḥalīfa gharāmi
qad ḥaththanī ḥibbu taqādama ʿahduhu wadhimāmuhu ʾaqwā bikulli dhimāmi
yā laytanī yadrī surūrī ʾidh ʾatā yabghī llaṭāʾifa ʿinda ẓilli muqāmī
famajālu shiʿri fiyyā laysa muʿassarā kala wala yabdū bidhāka huyāmī
rumḥu l-qawāfī lana ʿindī matnuhu la ʾashtakī laḥnā bisilki niẓāmī
yā ḥibbu ʾinnī rāʾimu biʾijābati ʾajibi l-ḥamīma taḥuz bikhayri marām
